label: Temelimab versus placebo in patients with post-COVID condition.
summary: More than 400 million individuals are estimated to have been affected by post-COVID condition or long COVID. This condition can lead to significantly decreased quality of life and increased individual and societal costs. Temelimab, a monoclonal IgG4 backbone antibody targeting HERV-W ENV, may be a potential treatment for post-COVID. In this randomized, double-blind trial, which consisted of a 24-week treatment period, we enrolled adults who had fatigue and persistent symptoms due to post-COVID…
